title: NFR-010 budget breach: exceeding the session budget throttles instead of silently overspending
risk: A runaway conversation with an unbounded tool loop burns cost with no limit, and the overrun is discovered only after the month closes.
preconditions: Namespace gov-nfr-<case_id>-<worker_id>; NFR verification runs against the offline gateway with mock SoR and channel boundaries.
Frozen clock 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z; failure, outage and crash injections are scripted at the substituted boundary, never faked inside the assertion.
A tenant session budget is configured as a labelled synthetic design target of 1.00 TWD per session (ECN-003 provisional).

steps.action: Run turns until accumulated cost approaches the budget
steps.expected: Cost is accumulated per turn and the session total is visible after each turn.

steps.action: Exceed the budget on the next turn
steps.expected: The session is throttled or degraded with a typed budget-breach state; the turn is not silently completed at full cost.
The customer receives a bounded fallback response (for example escalation to a human) rather than an endless loop.
The breach is recorded with the accumulated cost and the budget used, and the cost rows still sum to the measured total.

assertions: The budget breach produces a typed state and a behaviour change, not an unbounded continuation.
Accumulated cost never exceeds the budget by more than one turn's cost, and the overrun is recorded.
The customer experience degrades gracefully (escalation or bounded reply) instead of hanging.
Cost records reconcile to the measured total even across the breach.
forbidden: Ignoring the budget and logging a warning.
Cutting the session off with no customer-facing handling.
Resetting the counter so the session can overspend repeatedly.
evidence: Session cost accumulation log across turns.
Budget-breach state record with accumulated and limit values.
cleanup: Delete gov- session and cost rows.
automation: Core PEP, rules engine, audit writer, idempotency store and worker lease logic run as real code under test; only ERP/WMS, channel gateways, Redis and the model provider are substituted. Faults are injected at those boundaries and waits are condition-based on persisted state.
prerequisites: The 0.5-1 TWD per-session budget is a provisional design target pending the ASM-002 baseline; the case exercises the control, not an approved cap.
note: Generated acceptance specification. Plain specification, not an executable test; no application runtime exists, so the status is NOT_RUN.
